item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena is helping her grandmother clean rice for cooking. She notices small iron nails mixed with the rice grains in the container.

She wants to remove the nails quickly without touching each one by hand.

Which method should Meena use, and why?

options.A: Handpicking, because iron nails are too small to be attracted by a magnet.
options.B: Magnetic separation, because iron is magnetic and the magnet can pull the nails out of the rice.
options.C: Magnetic separation, because a magnet can pick any visible solid out of a mixture.
options.D: Handpicking, because a magnet will attract the rice grains along with the nails.
